_comment: Paths-only tsconfig for design-sync. Do NOT add an `include`/`exclude` glob here: lib/bundle.mjs strips block comments with a regex that treats the `/*` inside "@/*" as a comment opener and runs to the first `*/`, which in a normal tsconfig is inside a glob like "src/**/*.ts" — that eats the paths block, JSON.parse fails, and the alias plugin silently becomes null. The second target on each rule is the .js-shim tree from prepare-shims.mjs, tried after the real path misses.
